text:
dmitri: Heads-up — planning mTLS hardening & telemetry consolidation across EU/APAC services next week. Need RBAC maintenance windows + KMS audit checklist. Who's available?

sara: I'm free Tue/Wed afternoon EU. Can do RBAC runbook review.

kevin: I can handle keystore rollout steps and cmk binding. Need to confirm key alias naming.

megan: I/O: we'll need to validate prefix caching doesn't leak client cert CNs. Also audit log schema changes.

dmitri: Key items: 
- 1) RBAC: temp role for rotator with limited unwrap
- 2) KMS: verify decrypt logs + requestor principal
- 3) Audit: ensure tls_handshake_success & peer_identity fields
- 4) Rollout: staggered by region, start with staging -> eu -> apac

kevin: Proposed short checklist snippet:
```bash
# check keystore decrypt path
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.enc --key-id alias/redwood-rotator-eu
```
Also will attach a small script to verify unwrap metrics.

sara: For RBAC we should use least-priv role: `rotator.unwrap` + 'logs:write' limited to rotator logs. Add TTL 24h.

audit-bot: Automated: observed missing tls_peer_identity field on eu-ingest 03:12 UTC — 17% of handshakes. Ticket #INC-8421

megan: That's the exact symptom we saw during last rotator deploy. Could be a certchain short-circuit in the proxy.

kevin: Quick triage command for handshake debug:
```bash
openssl s_client -connect eu-ingest-01.redwood.internal:443 -showcerts -tls1_3
# look for 'Client Certificate' and 'Verify return code'
```

dmitri: If audit-bot is seeing 17%, we should block rollout to prod until we fix. Proposed plan:
1) small canary in eu (2 nodes)
2) enable extra debug logs for handshakes
3) validate KMS unwrap traces (correlate request_id)
4) run an audit reingest job to backfill missing fields

sara: Agree. Also we need change control: notify customer-facing teams + security review panel.

megan: I'll spin up a staging canary and run a replay load to reproduce.

kevin: I'll prep a PR with the CMK alias migration and RBAC role json. Example role:
```json
{
  "Role": "rotator_temp",
  "Permissions": ["kms:Decrypt","logs:PutLogEvents"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu:123456:key/xxxx"
}
```

dmitri: Nice. @oncall can you allocate a 2-hour maintenance window Wed 15:00-17:00 UTC for eu staging? We'll avoid prod until green.

oncall: Wed 15:00-17:00 UTC booked. Will page if anything spikes.

megan: Running replay now, will post logs. If anyone has a quick script to correlate tls_peer_identity -> kms_request_id, share pls.

kevin: I have a tiny jq one-liner:
```bash
jq -r '.events[] | select(.fields.tls_peer_identity) | "\(.fields.tls_peer_identity) \(.fields.kms_request_id)"' handshakes.json
```

dmitri: Perfect. After staging passes, we'll run a rolling canary in eu prod (5% traffic) and monitor audit metrics for 2 hours. If tls_peer_identity drops >2% abort.

sara: I'll update the runbook and post the change approval stub.

audit-bot: Note: creating audit ticket AU-3742 for reingest job and schema patch.

megan: Replay shows the same missing field on proxy v1.7.1 — debug log attached. Suspect SNI forwarding bug.

kevin: Workaround: pin proxy to 1.7.0 for canary while we patch. I'll open rollback PR.

dmitri: OK. Action items summarized: kevin PR for CMK & rollback, megan staging replay + logs, sara runbook+change control, oncall window. We reconvene Wed 14:30 UTC for preflight.

sara: :thumbsup:

kevin: :shipit:

megan: Will post results in this thread.

audit-bot: AU-3742 created. Linked to INC-8421.

dmitri: Thanks team — closing for now, we'll pick up Wed. If anything urgent, page me.
